cardEffects:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 3 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon that's level 6 or has the [Legend-Arms] trait, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as that Digimon.
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)
[When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon may attack.

jp.captionText: EX-06: Theme Booster Infernal Ascension (JP Sample)

inheritedEffect:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends.)
[Your Turn] While this Digimon is [RagnaLoardmon], the [Security] effects on cards checked by this Digimon don't activate.
name: Durandamon

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  The activation conditions include paying 3 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 6 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 3 cost.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 3 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 6 Digimon?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  This effect does not allow you to attack with Digimon that are in a state where they can't attack.
rulings.question: Can I use a Digimon that was played this turn or a suspended Digimon to attack with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

rulings.answer: No, it doesn’t activate.  The activation timing for the [Security] effect is before the battle with the Security Digimon, so even if a [RagnaLoardmon] with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted in battle, the [Security] effect can't be activated.
rulings.question: If a [RagnaLoardmon] with this card in digivolution cards is deleted in battle against a Security Digimon, does that Security Digimon's [Security] effect activate?
